# Manifest V3 schema catalog

Manifest V3 is the explicit exact-artifact contract. This page is generated from the embedded Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema used by package preflight.

Source of truth: Go catalogs under `apps/api` (`app/Support/Events`, `Capabilities`, `ExtensionManifest`, `Jobs`, and provider slot constants). Regenerate with:

```bash
cd apps/api && go run ./cmd/sforum extension docs generate
```

Or verify CI drift:

```bash
cd apps/api && go run ./cmd/sforum extension docs generate --check
```

## Declaration families

- Runtime and registries: `backend`, `routes`, `guards`, `hooks`, `events`, `jobs`, `schedules`, `providers`, `services`, and `commands`.
- Presentation and content: `components`, `templates`, `assets`, `content`, `adminSurfaces`, `navigation`, and `regions`.
- Data and identity: `migrations`, `database`, `cache`, `queries`, `queryResultFilters`, `identity`, `permissionDefinitions`, and `media`.
- Package composition: `dependencies`, `lifecycle`, `openapi`, `packageFiles`, and `includes`.

Themes remain presentation-only. Plugin permission definitions use `assignmentPolicy: host`; install or enable code never grants roles. Permission `label` and `description` may be a default string or an extension-owned locale map; the Host resolves them for its permission catalog without copying extension text into Core locale files. Raw request guards, raw/kernel database authority, lifecycle execution, backend binaries, migrations, and L2 files enter exact-artifact trust review before first execution.

## Exact-artifact workflow

```bash
cd apps/api
go run ./cmd/sforum extension digest --write <package-root>
go run ./cmd/sforum extension validate <package-root>
go run ./cmd/sforum extension test <package-root>
```

`digest --write` refreshes inline `packageFiles` SHA-256 values after local file changes and revalidates the package. Validation resolves all include shards without executing package code.

## Compatibility

- Omitted `manifestVersion` remains the V1 compatibility contract.
- Explicit V2 remains accepted.
- V3 packages must set `manifestVersion: 3`; V3-only declarations in V1/V2 packages fail instead of upgrading implicitly.
- Future manifest versions fail closed until the host implements them.

Authoritative schemas: `apps/api/app/Support/ExtensionManifest/schemas/manifest-v3.schema.json` and `contracts/openapi/schemas/extensions-v3-*.yaml`. Reference fixtures: `apps/api/app/Support/ExtensionManifest/testdata/v3/`.
